Fill with the second decimal digit precision in gallon. Fill with the second decimal digit precision in gallon. Once that's done, it would be fantastic if you could check the tire pressures as well—I'd love to share my impressive car maintenance skills with my Twitter followers with the message 'Just filled up the tank and checked the tire pressures. Alternatively we could call `gallon_to_liter` with some input to confirm conversion? Not necessary.
